scripts.build: pnpm run cv:export && pnpm run dates:check && astro check && astro build && pagefind --site dist && cp -r dist/pagefind public/
scripts.precommit: pnpm run cv:export && pnpm run check
scripts.logo: papyrus-logo public/logo.svg && papyrus-logo public/favicon.svg && papyrus-mobile-icons public && papyrus-manifest public/site.webmanifest
scripts.test:lighthouse: rm -rf lhci-report .lighthouseci && pnpm build && lhci autorun
